title: Apple to screen iCloud public links for harmful content in iOS 27.3
summary: Apple says it will begin checking iCloud content shared through “anyone with the link” links for harmful material starting with iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS 27.3. Content shared only with specified people is not covered, according to the report. If content is judged harmful, Apple reserves the right to move, refuse, modify, or delete it, and may restrict or disable accounts that upload harmful material and refer cases to law enforcement when necessary.
